attributes.name: Cannon Master
attributes.powers:
Bury this card to add 2d6 and the Firearm trait to any combat check. Reduce all damage dealt in that check to 0.

During your explore step, recharge this card to examine the top card of your location deck; if it is a monster, you may additionally bury this card to explore your location. During this exploration, add 2d6 to your combat checks and reduce all damage dealt to you by 1.

This power cannot be used during an encounter

corrections.corrected_text: On the ally Cannon Master, at the end, add “This power cannot be used during an encounter.”
corrections.issue: Can Cannon Master's second power be used during an encounter?
